notes: Capability-focused model card (arxiv:2607.00248), not a safety system card: no risk-framework decisions, external safety testers, or standard safety evals (jailbreak, CBRN, cyber offense, etc.). Only hallucination (LongFact/FactScore/HallusionBench) and VLMsAreBiased marked as covered safety-adjacent topics. Almost all model facts (params, context window, cutoff, license, training) are not stated; modalities taken from multimodal/vision/video text. Capped at 600 results with priority: safety-related rows, Seed2.0 Pro, then frontier comparison models, then Lite/Mini/Seed1.8 — so Lite/Mini have few rows left under the cap (Pro and comparisons dominate). Full Lite/Mini tables exist in the PDF (Tables 4, 8, 9, 12, 14). Omitted Human video baselines, Deepseek-Prover-V2 Putnam '<4.0', Table 1 pricing, Tables 17–18 case-study cryptanalysis, and Table 13/14 rows that duplicate Tables 3/11/12. Seed2.0 Lite/Mini use rawModelName (only Pro is a seed model id).
